I Met Jackson Pollock on 2C-B
Trip report: MDA 100mg, 2C-B 170mg in total (snorted in four lines throughout the night), BOD 30mg
I decided to have myself one hell of a crazy night last night. I took 100mg MDA and then immediately snorted a 50mg line of 2C-B. This event will constitute time.
T+0:30- The MDA is starting to kick in and I was surprised how different it was from MDMA. It was far less physically stimulating for me, yet much more euphoric and psychedelic. Im also peaking around this time from the first 50mg line of 2C-B, so the visuals are even more intense in nature than I couldve possibly expected from something like MDA alone. I decided to put Django Unchained on as its one of my favorite films of all time.
T+2:00- The MDA is still going strong, pulsating euphoria all throughout my body, but the 2C-B is wearing off. Fortunately, I have more! I rack up another 50mg line and snort it, and this second line is what really got me to the other realm Id wanted to visit yesterday. Django was still on, but I couldnt follow the plot despite having seen the movie at least 30 times. Colors were dripping off my walls and my ceiling was swirling around like the infamous spiral in Tools song Lateralus. At this point, it wasnt even easy for me to communicate. I remember trying to talk to people on here but eventually I had to just admit I was too high and to give up.
T+3:00- The movie is over. I go out into my roommates room to see what shes up to. Shes not a fan of my tripping, so she didnt really wanna hang out but I accepted that as a valid answer and decided Id just have to be responsible for my own entertainment. I ate a bagel around this point, and oh good god damn was it amazing. I went back to my room, realized that I was on two drugs that are both known aphrodisiacs, and commenced choking the chicken (yes, I usually masturbate the first time Im taking a new compound or combo, just to see what its like). This was a great experience, although Id imagine it wouldve been better on MDMA than MDA.
T+4:30- 2C-B redose time! I rack up another 50mg line and snort it. This is the one that ended up actually hurting my nose. The first ten minutes after taking that line were very unpleasant to say the least but I got through it, and when it subsided I became aware of just how hard I was tripping. Snorting 2C-B is WAY different than taking it orally. I need much less of it, it lasts 2-3 hours instead of 6-8, and I start tripping total ballsack within literal minutes of snorting. Its definitely an intense experience that I do NOT recommend to newcomers, especially at the massive doses I was using last night. DO NOT TAKE THIS MUCH 2C-B UNLESS YOU ARE EXPERIENCED IN 2C-B AND OTHER PHENETHYLAMINES AS WELL!!
Well, anyway, nothing was recognizable by its regular form. My tapestries were just blobs of dripping colors. The TV was broadcasting gibberish, both visually and audibly. I pretty much ceased to be me and allowed myself to fully fall into whatever realm this 2C-B wanted to show me. Keep in mind, Im still on MDA as well. I laid in my bed motionless just staring around my room for at least an hour, unable to do anything but take in these mind blowing visuals and hearty sense of euphoria courtesy of the MDA.
T+6:00- I have 20mg of 2C-B left, and I decide Im going to snort that last 20mg line. I also decide to measure out 30mg of BOD to add to this already-majestic cocktail. Right after snorting the last of my 2C-B, I parachute the 30mg BOD. This last line of 2C-B, being less than half the size of the others, didnt do as much visually and Ive also noticed that the MDA has pretty much worn off by this point.
T+6:30- People who Ive talked to often compare BOD to MAL and other mescaline analogs. Those people are absolutely right. Had I taken this without knowing what it was, I wouldve assumed Id taken a small dose of MAL. Theres a mild but not-overwhelming body load, colors become enhanced, and the headspace remains quite neutral even though between that and all the 2C-B, Im still tripping extremely hard.
T+7:30- The 2C-B is dissipating. The BOD is not, but by this point I know I shouldve taken a higher dose. The effects (which are still virtually identical to MAL) are there, but underwhelming. I also find another similarity to MAL in the sense that despite the fact Im tripping, BOD makes me sleepy and not stimulated at all. The brightness and vivid nature of colors is by far the most noticeable effect, and the headspace is so neutral and not difficult to navigate that I figure I could probably go to work on this compound if I ever really wanted to. I do, however, prefer MAL if I have to compare the two. Maybe it was just because I didnt take enough BOD, but I kind of looked at BOD as MAL Lite.
T+10:00- Im tired, and the BOD is definitely exacerbating that fact. Strange for a phenethylamine to induce sleepiness but nonetheless, Im tired and ready to call it a night. I take a Xanax bar and a 300mg Seroquel and within twenty minutes, Im fast asleep. The sleep left me well-rested and in a good mood today.
Post-trip thoughts: I LOVE pushing myself with 2C-B. Im always able to handle the visuals without becoming anxious and I also find its a wonderful compound to mix other compounds with. This was also my first time ever doing MDA, and I had a very positive opinion of that as well. It was quite different from the MDMA I remember taking as a teenager, but it was still a fantastic, euphoric, all-around good time. BOD, on the other hand, is something I doubt Ill buy again. I do have 70mg left to try once more before Im out, but honesty I think if I want a compound like this in the future Ill just order MAL.
Overall experience: 8/10, this was a fantastic trip and Im definitely not done exploring mixing 2C-B with entactogens. The 2C-B visuals were wildly intense but manageable, the MDA provided additional euphoria, and even the BOD enhanced the end of the trip for a few hours. Im going to say this again, though: DO NOT TAKE THE DOSES OF 2C-B THAT I TAKE. There are probably a few of you with my similar level of experience who would be okay but the doses I took last night are MASSIVE and are not to be taken as starter doses for people not familiar with the compound. Thank you to everyone who took the time to read this!
-Mr. T
